Refund Policy

Last updated: [[EFFECTIVE_DATE]]

  • Cancel any time. Your perks last to the end of the month you've paid for.
  • Changed your mind? Ask within 14 days of your first Supporter payment for a full refund.
  • Charged by mistake or twice? We'll always refund that.

Cancelling

Open Premium in the game and press Manage. That takes you to Stripe, where you can cancel. You won't be charged again, and your Supporter perks stay on until the end of the month you've already paid for.

Refunds

Your first payment

If you're not happy, email us within 14 days of your first Supporter payment and we'll refund it in full and end the subscription. This applies wherever you live, and covers the EU and UK right to withdraw from an online purchase.

Renewals

Monthly renewals aren't refunded, and we don't refund part of a month when you cancel - your perks just last to the end of it. Cancel before your renewal date to avoid the next charge.

Mistakes

If you were charged twice, charged after cancelling, or charged when you didn't mean to subscribe, email us and we'll refund it.

Where the law says otherwise

If your local consumer law gives you more right to a refund than this policy, that law applies.

Deleting your account

Deleting your account (Settings, then Delete account) cancels your subscription straight away. Because the account and its perks are gone, any time left in the month isn't refunded - unless you're within the 14 days above, so email us first if you want that refund.

How to ask

Email [[CONTACT_EMAIL]] from the email on your account (or tell us your display name), with the date of the charge. We reply within 3 working days. Refunds go back to the card you paid with and usually show up within 5-10 days.

Chargebacks

Please talk to us before disputing a charge with your bank - it's quicker for you. If a payment is disputed, the subscription is cancelled while it's looked into.

See also our Terms of Service. Questions? Email [[CONTACT_EMAIL]].
